bullets.text: BT Launches Sovereign Platform - **BT** introduces a platform for UK businesses to enhance control over networks and data.
ISPs Must Offer More - **Incognito** highlights the need for ISPs to provide value-added services beyond just speed.
Virgin Media Fined £23.8m - **Ofcom** penalizes Virgin Media for endangering vulnerable customers during digital landline migration.
Wi-Fi 8 and AI Integration - The future of **Wi-Fi** focuses on reliability and AI management for improved user experience.
AWS Targets Sovereign AI - **AWS** launches AI Factories to meet the growing demand for sovereign AI solutions.
5G Monetization Challenges - Carriers must focus on monetizing **5G** before considering the transition to 6G.
Mimosa's FWA Solution - **Mimosa** offers a cost-effective alternative to private 5G with fixed-wireless access solutions.
Telcos Embrace AI-as-a-Service - Telecom operators are evolving to offer **AI** solutions alongside traditional connectivity.
Vodacom Gains Control of Safaricom - **Vodacom** increases its stake in **Safaricom** to 55% for strategic growth.
Nokia's Private 5G Strategy - **Nokia** faces scrutiny over its restructuring amid a major offshore 5G project.
